I found this book to be quite superficial, with only about a 30% (90 pages out of 300) devoted to basic electricity and magnetism. The rest of the book is devoted to electrical technology – the telegraph, telephone, Atlantic Cable, Electric Lighting, Radio, TV and even Power generation through Nuclear Energy. All of these topics, plus the initial ones on static electricity, early batteries, Michael Faraday and Joseph Henry, are covered in a very superficial manner.
